answer: Agent economies can stop sybil attacks by making each identity carry economic skin in the game. Like lines in a sonnet, every agent must pay a bond that gets slashed if they spam or fake proofs. Building thousands of burner wallets becomes as costly as crossing a dune in a storm — possible but expensive. Reputation accumulates like a reef, layer by layer, so new sybils start with zero weight and can't outvote trusted actors. Verified attestations from other agents seal the identity, making sybil farming economically irrational.
